target.first_milestone: restricted-content Long Yao preparation and card-order policy
target.final_milestone: complete current-season Long Yao matches, including profession and fate choices
target.opponents: all supported characters, not only Long Yao

evidence.paper_compute: Reported main line: 8 H200 GPUs, 128 CPU cores; 1900 GPU-hours for 23 delivered stages, excluding other runs.
evidence.present_data: 439 whole human Long Yao games; 6526 deduplicated boards; split 349/45/45 games; first auxiliary GPU pretraining completed.
evidence.present_data_at_initial_design: Only 2 whole games with human Long Yao; 32 distinct exact-state observations, no Long Yao validation examples.

model_proposal.kind: structured entity transformer with autoregressive masked action heads
inputs: permitted opponent history and public resources
model_proposal.card_features: identity, card level, realm, cost, effect tags; optional frozen text features after ablation

data_plan.duplicates: group every perspective of the same source game; exact repeated states do not count as independent games
data_plan.split: whole-game grouped train/validation/test, with a separate newer-time holdout; diagnostic sample retired from independent final evaluation
pretraining: shuffle an observed owned board multiset and learn demonstrated order, without claiming the original acquisition process
shared card/state representation from compatible Cloud Sword and Long Yao examples
state/battle value labels only with verified timing and player identity; final-rank labels only when identity is reliable
excluded_labels: post-decision cumulative candidates presented as pre-action observations
data_plan.data_shortage_fallback: validated simulator search teachers and scripted policies generate new explicit trajectories; never fabricate human actions

work: Cloud Sword cards and one initial profession
seasonal fate triggers and cross-effect dispatch
curriculum.gate: all content admitted to the current curriculum must execute; full-match fixture outcomes never become RL labels
held-out game split, downstream card-combat benefit, compare with identical-budget training from scratch

work: pick board from own available hand
profession choice after initial fixed-profession curriculum
curriculum.teacher: bounded search over legal actions against distributions of permitted opponent states; no hidden-state oracle

work: one learning Long Yao seat versus seven coherent replay-library tracks
maintain simulated opponents' life and one-use ledgers
mix scripted responders and frozen prior policy checkpoints after baseline
curriculum.reward: primarily terminal placement; any round shaping bounded and checked for objective distortion
curriculum.budget_units: agent action decisions, not battles or games; proposed checkpoints, not a promised strength threshold

work: paired initial conditions/seeds against script and search baselines
curriculum.statistics: bootstrap/confidence intervals grouped by independent lobby/opponent-source clusters, not repeated perspectives

hardware_estimates.current_machine: Windows preparation and validation; configured single Tesla T4 server, 8 vCPU, nominal32GiB, PyTorch CUDA auxiliary learner available; complete-match GPU PPO still pending.
hardware_estimates.minimum_experiment: single 12–16 GB GPU with reduced batch, plus CPU simulation; estimate to validate
hardware_estimates.recommended_first_training: single 24 GB GPU, 16–32 CPU cores, 64 GB RAM, NVMe scratch
hardware_estimates.higher_headroom: single 32 GB GPU and 32–64 CPU cores only if measured inference/update or rollout bottlenecks justify it
hardware_estimates.multi_gpu: not needed for the initial proposed model capacity; reconsider after end-to-end profiling
hardware_estimates.first_rental_use: 2–4 hour throughput and memory pilot after GPU learner integration, not a long reservation
hardware_estimates.duration: no reliable full-training duration yet; estimate from target agent decisions divided by measured end-to-end decisions/second, plus independent evaluation
hardware_estimates.current_machine_at_initial_design: CPU data/rule validation and small smoke runs; present NumPy learner has no GPU execution

implementation_before_gpu: replace or complement NumPy-only learner with GPU-capable training
batch policy inference over independent environments
persistent battle workers, then measure 1/2/4/8 worker scaling
profile full Long Yao episodes rather than extrapolate tiny basic-card microbenchmarks
freeze content/version/model contract and holdout sources for each run
open_decisions: initial fixed profession chosen by verified coverage and expanded human sample, then unlock profession policy
final deployment strength target and compute budget after pilot
